news.headline: AI Token Costs Are Changing the Hardware vs. Software Debate
news.summary: Rising AI token costs are pushing enterprises toward on-premises hardware, boosting Dell Technologies after strong earnings while MongoDB shares fell despite a beat, as capital rotates from cloud software to hardware.
